node: .box in the sketch frame (first real user: the floor-olog sketch)

id.comment: fold key — latest node per id wins; stable identity across relabels

label.comment: the noun-phrase (olog reading: 'a box', 'the event log')

node_kind.comment: optional typing: machine / event-kind / functor / object — lexicons type payloads; the graph store is kind-agnostic

geom.comment: seed layout; afterwards geometry is owned by box_geometry acts (same fold, name = node id)

node.comment: creation/relabel act. First instance: the floor-olog sketch — the runtime's own vocabulary, drawn in the runtime.

create.via: POST /act (agent seeds; a plane-side 'new box' gesture is feature 3, unbuilt)

system.tick: shared 2s poll (sketch frame folds node + edge + box_geometry)
system.ingest: server drain validates against this registry entry

render.template: same box as geometry frame; label shows the noun-phrase; corner handles resize; label-drag is the link gesture (paper.edge)
ephemeral: rubber-band line while drawing an edge

comment: design-by-use provenance: fields earned by the sketch feature, not imagined. node_kind is deliberately untyped-here — when composition laws arrive (category ruling), edge lexicons carry them, node lexicons stay kind-agnostic.
